tasks.title: Implement TriageRouterImpl with threshold routing and label overrides
tasks.description: Implement server/app/triage/router.py with TriageRouterImpl class. Core logic: (1) result.error=True -> REVIEW_NEEDED; (2) label in always_escalate_labels -> ESCALATE_TO_CA (or ALERT_DIRECT if CA disabled); (3) label in always_alert_labels -> ALERT_DIRECT; (4) confidence <= borderline_low -> SILENT; (5) confidence >= borderline_high -> ALERT_DIRECT; (6) borderline zone + CA enabled -> ESCALATE_TO_CA; (7) borderline zone + CA disabled -> ALERT_DIRECT/SILENT by baseline_threshold. All exceptions caught -> REVIEW_NEEDED.
acceptance_criteria: confidence=0.29, label=abusive, CA=on -> SILENT
confidence=0.55, label=abusive, CA=on -> ESCALATE_TO_CA
confidence=0.71, label=abusive, CA=on -> ALERT_DIRECT
confidence=0.55, label=violence, CA=on -> ESCALATE_TO_CA (label override)
confidence=0.55, label=violence, CA=off -> ALERT_DIRECT (override + CA disabled)
confidence=0.55, label=pornographic, CA=on -> ALERT_DIRECT (always_alert override)
result.error=True -> REVIEW_NEEDED regardless of confidence
Any exception inside decide() returns REVIEW_NEEDED and logs triage.decide.exception

tasks.title: Implement A/B context-blind baseline switch via CONTEXT_AGENT_ENABLED
tasks.description: Ensure the CONTEXT_AGENT_ENABLED=false path in TriageRouterImpl is fully exercised and auditable. When CA is disabled, the triage_decision audit field must still record 'alert_direct' or 'silent', and context_agent_enabled=false must be written to the request state audit dict. This is the clean A/B split required by PRD §6 and the research question measurement design.
acceptance_criteria: CONTEXT_AGENT_ENABLED=false: borderline case returns ALERT_DIRECT or SILENT (never ESCALATE_TO_CA)
request.state.audit['context_agent_enabled'] is False when CA is disabled
request.state.audit['triage_decision'] is written on every decide() call
request.state.audit['triage_label_override'] is True when a label override fired
Zero calls to context_agent.evaluate() when CA is disabled (verifiable via mock)
